courses.title: NEXT GENesis
courses.description: In Bereshit the story began. In us, it continues. A seven-part Rosh Chodesh Society course that reads the early narratives of Genesis as a mirror of the human soul: longing, choice, fracture and renewal.

courses.title: Kabbalah and the Hidden Architecture of You
courses.description: Reincarnation, soulmates, dreams, names: what these and other mysteries reveal about the hidden design of your life. A six-week course on the mystical backstory that explains the mysteries you never understood about yourself.
lessons: Echoes of Your Soul in Everyday Life
Traces of the Sefirot in Your Body and Soul
The Mystical Backstory of Your Soul
Signals from Heaven in Your Daily Life
The Ripples of Your Thoughts and Words
How You Can Touch Infinity in a Finite World
courses.dates: 6 sessions from Tue Oct 27 / Wed Oct 28, 2026

courses.title: Sinai and Civics: How Jewish Values Helped Shape American Ideals
courses.description: Timed to the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, a four-session course on the Jewish ethics, ideas and values that influenced America's founders and still shape American government and society.

courses.title: For All Humankind
courses.description: Your Judaism holds a message the world wants to hear. It's time to unlock it. A four-part course tracing Judaism's universal message from Abraham to today.

courses.title: Captivating Cases of Rabbinic Responsa
courses.description: Listen in on the surprising, practical questions your ancestors asked rabbis across Jewish history. A six-session tour of real-life questions and the answers rabbis wrote, balancing law, ethics, lived reality and survival.
lessons: The Questions and the People Who Asked Them

courses.title: Lift Your Life
courses.description: Kabbalistic teachings that will elevate your daily reality. Re-examine your basic activities and life features in the light of Jewish wisdom. It's time for an upgrade!
lessons: Sublimated Slumber: Harnessing the Secrets of Sleep
Reframing Rage: Dousing Anger and Deflecting Upset
Art of Eat: Managing Food and Munching for Meaning
Elated Living: Reaching and Reaping Genuine Joy
Lip Syncing: Working Wonders With Words
Living G-d: Logic and Faith in Our Divine Relationship
Divine Image Projection: Freeing and Implementing Our Potential

courses.title: The Kabbalah of Meaning
courses.description: Jewish wisdom for finding the purpose that connects all parts of life: what meaning is, where it comes from, and how to find it in daily routines, relationships, the rhythms of the calendar, and the circumstances we did not choose.
lessons: To Make or Not to Make Meaning
Meaning in the Rhythms of Time
I Mean Something, Therefore I Am

courses.title: Heaven on Earth
courses.description: A virtual tour of our Holy Temple. Join us for a three-week virtual tour of the Holy Temple, the home we shared with G-d, because envisioning the Temple and longing for it are the first steps toward rebuilding it.

courses.title: Colorful Profiles
courses.description: Short stories of extraordinary lives from Jewish history. A four-week journey to encounter twelve stories of Jewish history's most fascinating men and women: converts, captives, royal advisors, philosophers, philanthropists, and more.

courses.title: Decoding the Talmud
courses.description: Inside the story, substance, and significance of the book that defines Judaism. Learn the key terms, logical principles, and historical context required to decode every part of the Talmudic page.
lessons: The Jewish People and the Talmud

courses.title: A Work of Heart
courses.description: Between Me and G-d: How Jewish prayer unites Heaven and Earth. A monthly lunch-and-learn series for women that flings the cover off the Jewish prayer book, the prayer services, and the synagogue.
lessons: A Work of Soul: A New Paradigm for Prayer
A Work of Pleas: Understanding the Mechanics of Petition
A Work of Ascent: Making Sense of Liturgy, One Step at a Time
A Work of Praise: Finding G-d in Our World
A Work of Transcendence: Achieving True Transcendence in Prayer
A Work of Synthesis: Synthesizing Divinity and Materiality in the Amidah
A Work of Alliance: Finding Meaning in Communal Prayer

courses.title: Nurturing Relationships
courses.description: Relationships don't just happen; they're nurtured. Jewish wisdom for building deeper, richer connection in all your relationships, at home, at work, and beyond.
lessons: Direct communication on hard topics and handling conflict (Lesson 3)
Offering critique and guidance with care (Lesson 5)

courses.title: Decisions of Fate
courses.description: Your Jewish compass for navigating questions of medical ethics. Explore the guiding Jewish values that help inform choices in four areas: experimental treatments, extending life, pregnancy questions, and caring for a body.
courses.dates: 4 Wednesdays from Aug 7, 2024 (page labels it 'Spring 2024 course')

courses.title: Read it in Hebrew
courses.description: A five-session Hebrew reading crash course, guaranteed to be effective in only five sessions, using interactive flashcards and its own app. For all levels, from beginners to those who want a refresher.

courses.title: Advice for Life
courses.description: The Rebbe's advice for leading a more purposeful life. A multimedia journey through the Lubavitcher Rebbe's practical wisdom on work, family, health, and well-being.

courses.title: One Wow Moment
courses.description: How do we empower ourselves to make courageous and meaningful decisions? A peek at pivotal moments of personal decision in the lives of seven women of biblical fame. (Third annual women's lunch-and-learn series.)

courses.title: The World of Kabbalah
courses.description: Revealing how its mystical secrets relate to you. Discover the core mystical and spiritual teachings of Kabbalah and their relevance to everyday life, and learn to think like a Jewish mystic.

courses.title: How Happiness Thinks
courses.description: The world's happiest kept secret. An exciting journey into your own mind and psyche, drawing on classical Jewish and mystical teachings, and how positive psychology now corroborates what Judaism has always known about what makes us happy.
lessons: How to Feel Good About Yourself Without Becoming Self-Absorbed
How to Remain Happy Through Times of Stress
The Art of Gratitude: Why Aren't We Happy with What We Have?
How Our Shortcomings Can Become Sources of Joy
How to Cope Through Times of Loss

courses.title: Cultivating Character: Pirkei Avot
courses.description: Imagine you can go out for coffee with Judaism's greatest sages... A six-week study series on Pirkei Avot (Ethics of Our Fathers), a beloved compilation of timeless sayings from the sages of old.
courses.dates: 6 Fridays from June 16 (year inferred as 2023), on Zoom

courses.title: Jewpernatural
courses.description: Signs, spirits and superstition in Jewish belief. Delve into the mystical and mysterious world of dreams, angels, demons, and extraterrestrials through the Talmud, Jewish philosophy, and Kabbalah.

courses.title: Book Smart
courses.description: A grand tour through the vast sea of Jewish wisdom and learning: a panoramic overview of 3000 years of Jewish learning, from Tanach and Midrash to Talmud, Halachah, philosophy, Kabbalah, Musar and Chasidism.

courses.title: To Believe or Not to Believe in Yourself
courses.description: How do we navigate our inner complexity and chart a clear path for ourselves? A monthly lunch-and-learn series for women, created and taught by women for women. (Second annual series.)
lessons: Living on the Ledge of the In-Between
The Long and Short of It. The Short and Long of It.
Worst Case Scenario? Best Case Scenario?
Wheeling and Dealing to Feeling the Healing

courses.title: My G-d
courses.description: Nothing is off-limits as this refreshingly open course asks piercing questions about G-d: His nature, His purpose for creation, how we experience Him, and the role of religion, miracles and prayer.

courses.title: Survival of a Nation
courses.description: One fateful week in June 1967 redrew the map of the Middle East. A course on the Six-Day War and Israel today that confronts the impossible yet important questions our nation faces from a unique Jewish perspective.

courses.title: Beyond Right
courses.description: The values that shape Judaism's civil code. Beneath the Talmudic discussion and legalese lie the core Jewish values that fuel the debate; explore fascinating legal and ethical issues and uncover the values that make us who we are.

courses.title: Meditation from Sinai
courses.description: The Torah was given at Sinai. So were the meditative tools to help us open up, see more, and live more deeply. Jewish teachings on mindful awareness, spirituality, and meditative practice for new and experienced meditators.
lessons: Mind Control: I Think Therefore I Can
Spiritual Awakening: Tune In, Play On
Here and Wow: Free Every Moment
Club Med: Eat Better, Sleep Deeper, Work Higher
Act Natural: Climb the Mountain Do
courses.dates: 6 sessions from Wed Feb 2 / Thu Feb 3, 2022

courses.title: Well-Connected
courses.description: Judaism is less a system of belief than a system of action. Well-Connected reveals the soul of Jewish ritual life by showing how to make each mitzvah personal, and a way to connect to something beyond ourselves. (A new monthly lunch-and-learn series for women.)

courses.title: Outsmarting Antisemitism
courses.description: We cannot let antisemitism define our Judaism, but we cannot ignore it either. The course takes this dark subject on squarely, with illuminating source texts and captivating case studies, to fight hate with hope.
courses.dates: 4 sessions from Wed Nov 3 / Thu Nov 4, 2021

courses.title: Judaism Decoded
courses.description: Judaism Decoded is a unique exploration of the inner workings of Judaism, shedding light on the logic behind Torah law and the Talmudic debate.

courses.title: This Can Happen
courses.description: For thousands of years, the prophecies of a “messianic age” stretched the imaginations of even the most fervent believers. Not anymore. A credible case for feeling good about the future.

courses.title: Journey of the Soul
courses.description: Who hasn't wondered what happens when we die? A fresh look at life, death and the rest—in peace: the soul's journey before birth and after death.
courses.dates: From Wed Feb 3 / Thu Feb 4, 2021, on Zoom

courses.title: Secrets of the Bible
courses.description: Revisit six seemingly absurd biblical stories you likely remember from Hebrew school. Iconic stories, mystical meanings, and lessons for life.
lessons: Would you choose knowledge over paradise?
How do you see past another's failures?
Will the real you please stand up?
Your life and its goals: are they compatible?
Does a higher station make you a better person?

courses.title: High Holidays: Making it Meaningful at Home
courses.description: This year don't just zoom by the High Holidays, learn how to experience them in a special way at home. A four-part series exploring these special days.
lessons: Simchas Torah: Making it Super Joyful

courses.title: Pirkei Avot Studies
courses.description: Life wisdom from the Ethics of our Fathers.

courses.title: Judaism at Home
courses.description: Don't let social distancing get in the way of spiritual connection and exciting learning! How to imbue beauty, purpose, and spirituality into our daily mundane activities while living in quarantine.

courses.title: The Jewish Course of Why
courses.description: Ever wondered why there are so many Jews in Hollywood? 50 of the biggest questions about Jews and Judaism, from a survey of 30,000 people, in twelve 45-minute online classes.
courses.dates: Twice weekly from Mon March 23, 2020, online

courses.title: Judaism's Gifts to the World
courses.description: Unpack six of the world’s most cherished values and how they were delivered to humankind by the Torah. How major Jewish ideas evolved into universal values.

courses.title: Worrier to Warrior
courses.description: We yearn to feel happy, self-assured, and enthusiastic, yet we’re consumed by feelings of doubt, regret and worry. Jewish secrets to feeling good however you feel: a six-week course blending Torah and psychology.

courses.title: Paradigm Shift
courses.description: Paradigm Shift offers a revolutionary and empowering outlook on life, culled from the wisdom of the Lubavitcher Rebbe, marking his 25th yahrzeit: an elevator ride to the heights of what is possible.

courses.title: With All My Heart
courses.description: Discover the Jewish art of prayer and spirituality in our newest six-session course, whether you’re seeking relief from stress or hoping for focus, clarity, and connection.

courses.title: Crime and Consequence
courses.description: In Crime and Consequence, we explore 3000 years of Jewish law and wisdom concerning criminal convictions, sentencing, and rehabilitation.

courses.title: Wrestling with Faith
courses.description: Where is the evidence for G-d? Tackling the biggest questions and challenges to faith, from Jewish practice to science and religion.

courses.title: Heaven on Earth
courses.description: A three-week virtual tour of the Holy Temple, the home we shared with G-d. Discover the marvels of architecture and design that were integral to this sacred site.

courses.title: What Is?
courses.description: Rethink everything you know about our universe. Jewish mysticism on the building blocks of existence and the human condition.

courses.title: Communication: Its Art and Soul
courses.description: In the era of social media, the value of healthy communication among family members and associates is widely recognized. Reclaim the lost art of human connection.

courses.title: Great Debates in Jewish History
courses.description: Debate and disputation are not only encouraged within Judaism but reside at the very heart of Jewish history and theology. Six of the biggest debates that rocked the Jewish world, then and today.
lessons: To Be or Not To Be
courses.dates: 6 Monday evenings, Oct 30 - Dec 4, 2017, at Bloomfield Hills High School

notes: Source of the full page list: https://www.bhchabad.org/pages-sitemap.xml (97 URLs, all lastmod 2026-10-14). The sitemap index also lists booking-services-sitemap.xml (Wix Bookings only). The sitemap revealed 22 course pages that are not in the menu, /past-courses or /jliaudio: Well-Connected, Outsmarting Antisemitism, Meditation from Sinai, Beyond Right, Survival of a Nation, My G-d, To Believe or Not to Believe, Book Smart, Jewpernatural, Cultivating Character (Pirkei Avot), How Happiness Thinks, The World of Kabbalah, One Wow Moment, Advice for Life, Read it in Hebrew, Decisions of Fate, Nurturing Relationships, A Work of Heart, Decoding the Talmud, Colorful Profiles, Heaven on Earth 2025, Lift Your Life. It also revealed detail pages /athome and /highholidays, and 10 more recording pages (9 of them link a YouTube playlist).

Years for pages that print only month/day were worked out from the weekday (e.g. 'Wednesday, Nov 1' is 2023) together with the season label on the page. Each course's 'dates' field records the result.

Women's series: all six (2021-22 to 2026-27) are monthly Rosh Chodesh Society lunch-and-learns taught by Mrs. Mushky Dubov. Well-Connected and Lift Your Life name the RCS. To Believe and A Work of Heart use 'RCS83'/'RCS85' asset filenames. The pages call One Wow Moment the 'third annual' series and To Believe the 'second annual'. The 'year' field is the year the series started.
Decisions of Fate: the page calls it a 'SPRING 2024 COURSE' (JLI's spring 2024 release), but the sessions began Wednesday Aug 7, 2024, so it is filed as Summer 2024.

Read it in Hebrew: no year on the page. Thursday Feb 15 fits 2024 (and 2018). The newer ced623 assets, the Federation venue and the info@bhchabad.org contact all point to 2024. It is not a JLI course (series 'other'); taught by Mrs. Mushky Dubov.

Cultivating Character: Pirkei Avot (/pirkeiavot): no year on the page. Friday June 16 fits 2023, and the format (Fridays 11:00-11:45 on Zoom, Paperform) matches the later Torah Deep Dive. The Summer 2020 'Pirkei Avot Studies' audio card uses an image named 'Cultivating Character_Social Media_Square', so the 2020 series may have had the same title. The /highholidays page's meta description, copied from a 2020 Pirkei Avot page, calls it a 6-session series. Confirm with Rabbi Dubov whether this ran in 2020, 2023 or both.

JLI vs other: High Holidays: Making it Meaningful, Judaism at Home, Pirkei Avot Studies/Cultivating Character and Read it in Hebrew are marked 'other' because their pages don't say JLI. Judaism at Home and Pirkei Avot appear in the 'JLI audio archive', so they may have used JLI material.

Recordings: Book Smart and Jewpernatural recording pages both link the same playlist PLbHO_Q5DmD_N0cqormK__WFjIKOvGkY4N. One of them is probably a copy-paste error, so the right playlist for the other course needs checking in YouTube Studio.

Recordings marked 'wix-audio' (/whyaudio, /shift-audio, /pirkeiavotaudio, /giftsaudio, /copy-of-the-jewish-course-of-why-au, /jahaudio, /warrioraudio, /crimeaudio, /whatisaudio): these pages exist and are titled as audio recordings, but the player is JavaScript-rendered and was not visible to WebFetch. Export the MP3s from the Wix Media Manager. /whatisaudio (Spring 2018) is not linked from the /jliaudio grid.

No recording page or playlist was found for: Great Debates, Communication, Heaven on Earth (2018), Wrestling with Faith, Well-Connected and later women's series, World of Kabbalah, How Happiness Thinks, Advice for Life, Decisions of Fate, Nurturing Relationships, Decoding the Talmud, Colorful Profiles, Heaven on Earth (2025). Fall 2025 onward is on the Torah Deep-Dive podcast instead. They may exist as unlisted YouTube playlists on the channel.

YouTube: the channel URL/handle could not be retrieved (WebFetch got a generic YouTube response, and oEmbed/RSS were blocked). Playlist owner shows as 'Rabbi Levi Dubov'. All playlist IDs share the PLbHO_Q5DmD_ prefix, so they are from one channel.
Spotify: the RSS feed links episodes at podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/torah-deep-dive. The public open.spotify.com/show/ URL was not found (the podcasters.spotify.com fetch was not approved).

Course pages with lightbhchabad.org event IDs: 19284 (Colorful Profiles), 20065 (Heaven on Earth 2025), 20473 (Kabbalah of Meaning), 20623 (Lift Your Life), 21301 (Responsa), 22109 (For All Humankind), 22861 (Sinai & Civics), 23481 (NEXT GENesis), 23504 (Kabbalah Hidden Architecture). Earlier courses used Paperform, Google Forms or myjli.com registration.
Responsa and Sinai & Civics lesson titles come from the Torah Deep-Dive podcast episode titles. The Wix /responsa page shows only lesson descriptions and /sinai shows only icons.
Nurturing Relationships: the page shows lesson topics but no titles, so the topic summaries are used. The official titles are on myjli.com if wanted.
Descriptions combine the site's own sentences, trimmed and lightly joined. WebFetch limits verbatim quotes, so some clauses are close paraphrases of the page text. None were taken from myjli.com.
Cover URLs are the original Wix files with /v1/... transforms removed. Some legacy b988f4 assets keep Wix's old '~mv2_d_W_H_s_N' filename form; that is the real file id, not a transform.
Courses marked status 'current' (Kabbalah Fall 2026, NEXT GENesis 2026-27) are included for completeness. Leave them off a 'Past courses' page until they finish.

Possible gaps: no course found for Winter/Spring/Summer 2017 (the site starts at Fall 2017; a camera photo dated May 3, 2017 suggests earlier activity) or for a separate spring 2024 slot. The JLI location page (http://www.myjli.com/index.html?task=location&lid=12258, linked from /landing) may list the full JLI history; not fetched.

Photos: /pictures is a JavaScript Pro Gallery, and none of its images reached WebFetch. Only 3 candidate real photos were found in page HTML, and none could be looked at (the image fetch failed). Export the gallery from the Wix dashboard.
